snippet.title: 7 Nights Later Demo - Steam Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
I'm proud to share the demo of my game, which I developed all by myself.



Run a video store in a retro atmosphere.
Help Michelle, the main character, escape her strange and terrifying situation.
Uncover a dark mystery while struggling to survive — and become part of a psychological experience you’ll never forget!

🕹️ Features:

Retro PS1-inspired visuals
Randomly occurring events
A store simulation with a “sell movies – buy supplies” gameplay loop
A mysterious and suspenseful horror story
Multiple endings
Link: Steam/7_Nights_Later_Demo/
